summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K furnishing poll results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 20, 2026, plus clinical data announcements and a memorandum of association amendment. The AGM passed all proposed resolutions by poll, including share scheme grants to executives. There are no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, or other special-situation terms disclosed. This is a routine reporting of an ordinary shareholder meeting and corporate housekeeping items. Accordingly, no special-situation classification applies.
